caption: Live dashboard, study-002: the Agents board. Each role is a separate agent with its own budget, running and finished tasks.
Timeline: every task the controller admitted, refused or finished, read from the append-only ledger.
Needs & gates: unmet needs agents posted for others to claim, and gate verdicts recorded by a role other than the producer.
Artifacts: every committed record with its schema, producer, validation state and provenance.
Skills & agents: each role's operating procedure is editable with history. Studies run on a frozen copy, so edits only affect future studies.
Study-001 report (finished): built from committed, gated records only. Every number links to an artifact.
Phases and their outcome: the model gate failed, so intervention design and blinded evaluation were not run.
Virtual-patient modelling: R5 re-derived convergence from the raw draws. No region's excitability converged, so the pipeline was not qualified.
Quality controls: outcome blinding, independent checking, and the open needs the agents left for the next study.
Study-002, exploratory: virtual treatments on blinded virtual Patient 2. Ablating the estimated zone stopped simulated seizures in 5 of 12 fits; pulse-train stimulation did not.
